goal.en: Specify the selected business behavior precisely enough to implement and independently accept it.

graphPolicy.location: .starciwork node dependsOn/refs with direct sourceRefs and collocated assets

purpose.en: Read current target, ancestor scope, refs, dependencies, assertions and validator freshness. For an explicitly new target, absence is expected: inspect the nearest existing ancestor/workspace, then create only that selected scope. Preserve unaffected accepted content.

When source exists/is selected, resolve repository resource, actual checkout/root/HEAD and dirty state; read applicable instructions, manifests, owning code, callers and relevant tests. Greenfield/spec-only work records source not-yet-created and grounds intent in the user request; no invented repository or fact citation. Source implementation still needs an actual selected writable repository.

reads.path: current accepted user intent + supplied domain documents

purpose.en: Classify each statement as intent, observed fact, example, proposal, unknown or contradiction, with source citation/revision. Existing behavior does not authorize a new rule.
Read the JSON field contract and this operator procedure before authoring the .starciwork payload.

Only when explicitly selected in a job matrix, read the exact cell ID, operation, immutable input bindings, requested output JSON shapes and required criteria. Standalone execution needs no fabricated matrix request. A template is not authority for extra effects.

reads.path: profiles/registry.json + selected runtime execution profile + actual host tools/model

purpose.en: Select the actual host runtime codex or claude and this operator role from the V2-derived active profiles. Use current host model configuration; historical model names are not availability proof. Capabilities are the intersection of actual tools, selected profile policy, op permissions and existing task authority. Do not revive V2 dispatch chains, retired profiles or extra-agent permissions.

content.en: Author business/overview/index.yaml with businessOverview for readable purpose, customer understanding, outcome, scope and open questions. Author the sole detailed SRS in extensions.work3.specification using starci/specification@2 on cohesive business/srs/**/index.yaml leaves. Intermediate folders are metadata-only aggregates; scale by adding folders, not editing a registry or duplicating a monolithic SRS. Stable FR/BR/NFR/flow/AC IDs and explicit core refs/dependsOn provide traceability. Do not repeat the detailed SRS in a compact business object. Preserve canonical user journeys and never turn internal service hops into UI actions.
Record requirement-to-acceptance coverage, concrete source observations and unresolved contradictions; a specification review is not implementation evidence.

Only for a selected job matrix, return the exact request-bound result. Populate every declared cell output with actual canonical Work/source/runtime references or produced JSON artifacts from this job; retain real artifact bytes and hashes. Do not rename/regenerate upstream expectations. Missing required output/evidence remains blocked or failed and cannot advance. The selected request freezes output field schemas before execution.

action.en: Resolve the canonical .starciwork workspace and selected business leaf. Research accepted intent, domain documents and current FE/BE callers at exact revisions. Classify every citation as accepted intent, observed source, proposal or unknown; source behavior never approves policy. Resolve the execution profile and actual tool availability before selecting instruments; this does not switch the model/runtime or spawn workers.

Write purpose, scope/exclusions, glossary, assumptions, actors with responsibilities/rights/restrictions, FR/BR and observable NFRs. Specify business data attributes, validation, sensitivity, states/transitions and external inputs/outputs/errors. State why a data or external-interface inventory is empty. Source observations and supplied technical constraints are not approved business policy; unknown numeric targets retain a decision owner.

Every FR resolves to a detailed flow, not a title alone: trigger, primary/supporting actors, inputs, preconditions, numbered actor/request/system-response steps, guards, effects, failures, repeat behavior and success/failure postconditions. Alternative and exception branches identify their starting step, condition, ordered steps, resume/end and acceptance. Review denied/invalid input, cancellation, duplicate/retry, concurrency and recovery where relevant; explain absent branch classes without fabricating cases.

Review observable outcomes against accepted intent and observed behavior. Business states what users and the system must do, not class inheritance, repositories, service placement, Saga/CQRS, Kubernetes or backup tooling. Preserve genuinely supplied technical constraints as sourced external constraints; hand implementation questions to Architecture instead of encoding an invented design in requirements.

Specify actor-action-resource permissions, tenant/owner boundaries, sensitive-data handling and abuse cases. Give each security requirement an observable denial/no-side-effect acceptance scenario; do not mistake a disabled UI control for server enforcement.

Intermediate folders are metadata-only aggregates; scale by adding folders, not editing a registry or duplicating a monolithic SRS. Stable FR/BR/NFR/flow/AC IDs and explicit core refs/dependsOn provide traceability. Do not repeat the detailed SRS in a compact business object. Preserve canonical user journeys and never turn internal service hops into UI actions.

Validate detailed requirement/flow/branch/acceptance coverage and the recursive Work graph. Review contradictions, scope and unresolved decisions with the user. A complete branch rolls up only from valid required leaves; draft placeholders and schema validity cannot earn done. Output reviewed business outcomes and observable security/quality acceptance for Architecture; no implementation or deployed-proof claim. Return the selected matrix's request-bound typed outputs when applicable.

requirement.en: Run workspace validation; every cited ID/path exists or is explicitly proposed, required assertions are covered, input bindings are current, and an honest not-run/fail cannot earn done.
Each applicable FR/NFR/BR has acceptance IDs and source intent; no vague fast/secure/user-friendly NFR is accepted as measurable. Implementation/UAT status is untouched.

Every FR has a detailed actor flow and acceptance, every alternative/exception has ordered steps and postconditions, and security has observable negative acceptance. Validate nested ownership and version-2 SRS; no code/service inventory is required in Business.

condition.en: A required rule, actor permission, numeric target or acceptance result has no authoritative decision.
Accepted sources conflict; preserve both citations and ask the actual owner, never average them.

A declared prerequisite is not effectively done, or a required declared input/scope is missing. Report node/resource IDs and propose a separately selected graph update when needed; never run predecessors or weaken dependsOn/refs/required to proceed.

placeholders.repo-id: Resolved direct repository name or path

specificationPolicy.payload: business/overview/index.yaml plus recursive business/srs/**/index.yaml leaves carrying extensions.work3.specification; branches aggregate.
specificationPolicy.sourceTruth: Current accepted Business/SRS in .starciwork and actual authorized intent define the target; all code is legacy observation, never requirement authority.
specificationPolicy.completion: Review proof and current .starciwork validation only; never implementation, Sonar or UAT pass.
specificationPolicy.handoff: Architecture consumes accepted SRS leaf IDs, requirements, flows and acceptance unchanged, including inherited scope. No code/service design or implementation checks belong in Business.

action.en: Resolve the canonical .starciwork workspace and current accepted business scope before authoring. Read docs/source-of-trust.md and research authorized intent and domain documents first. Existing code, including newly tested code, is legacy observation rather than requirement authority; consult it only when relevant to an explicitly requested implementation-gap observation. Classify citations as accepted intent, observed source, proposal or unknown. Never infer the intended product or constrain its flows from existing FE/BE behavior.

Source observations and supplied technical constraints are not approved business policy; unknown numeric targets retain a decision owner.

Trace each FR through a complete user journey, not a title alone: trigger, primary/supporting actors, inputs, preconditions, numbered actor/request/system-response steps, guards, effects, failures, repeat behavior and success/failure postconditions. Distinguish product users from external parties served on their behalf, initiators from recipients, and receipt of a request from completed work. Alternative and exception branches identify their starting step, condition, ordered steps, resume/end and acceptance. Proactively challenge denied/invalid input, cancellation, duplicate/retry, concurrency, partial failure, lost outcomes and recovery where relevant; explain absent branch classes without fabricating cases. Analysis is not perfect foresight: a gap found during review, coding, testing or later customer feedback enters the same authorized canonical SRS/SDS repair loop even after done.

Business states what users and the system must do, not class inheritance, repositories, service placement, Saga/CQRS, Kubernetes or backup tooling. Preserve genuinely supplied technical constraints as sourced external constraints; hand implementation questions to Architecture instead of encoding an invented design in requirements.

Specify actor-action-resource permissions, tenant/owner boundaries, sensitive-data handling and abuse cases. Give each security requirement an observable denial/no-side-effect acceptance scenario; do not mistake a disabled UI control for server enforcement.

Walk the complete scope as a user and downstream designer before first done; check shared boundaries, contradictory rules, observable results and significant missing cases. Resolve authorized elaboration yourself and ask the actual decision maker only for genuinely undecided business policy or scope. Repair an identified gap in its canonical owner and review affected consumers, not merely report it. A complete branch rolls up only from current reviewed required leaves; draft placeholders, green code tests and schema validity cannot earn done. Output reviewed business outcomes and observable security/quality acceptance for Architecture; no implementation or deployed-proof claim.

specificationPolicy.layout: business/index.yaml aggregates overview/index.yaml and srs/index.yaml; add cohesive folders recursively under srs with no registry. Branches have no stored state or SRS; leaves own complete SRS. Legacy accepted records remain readable without automatic migration.
